intro: Explain why each project belongs in the portfolio and what perspective the collection is designed to show.

items.title: Clear contribution
items.body: Include work where your role, decisions, and implementation responsibility can be described precisely.

items.title: Useful evidence
items.body: Prefer projects with screenshots, working flows, source, measured outcomes, or documented tradeoffs.

categories.label: Featured case study
categories.rationale: This project is included as the starter's complete example of an evidence-led product story.

omissions.title: What is not represented yet
omissions.body: Name important gaps rather than implying the portfolio covers every kind of work.

items.title: Long-term operations
items.body: The starter project does not claim evidence from operating a product over an extended period.

items.title: Team collaboration
items.body: Add review, planning, or handoff artifacts before making strong collaboration claims.

nextReview.title: When to review the selection
nextReview.body: Revisit the portfolio when a new project adds a genuinely different decision area or stronger evidence.
